items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I don't think it would come any greater than that boy Lorenzo.

ctx.x: Yeah. Can you tell me who was your favorite clarinet player of all that you heard any place or any time? Who would, if you had to listen to just one clarinet player once more who would you want to hear?

Well I'm going to tell you at the time, at my time when I was talking about, I don't think it would come any greater than that boy Lorenzo. I don't think it would come any greater. I don't think it could come
any greater. Was he good for jazz and everything? Oh I'm telling you, jazz, opera, brass band,
